reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness tools for inspecting and controlling Android devices through ADB, including device diagnostics, UI interaction, screenshots, app management, file transfer, logs, and optionally arbitrary device-side shell commands.

summaries.zh: 通过 ADB 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Android 设备发现、信息读取、界面交互、截图、应用管理、文件传输和日志查看工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with ADB tools for Android device discovery, inspection, UI interaction, screenshots, app management, file transfer, and log access.

capabilities: Discover and inspect connected Android devices
Read Android system, application, service, UI, and log information
Capture device screenshots and UI hierarchies
Send input events and text to Android devices
Install, launch, stop, clear, and uninstall applications
Transfer files between the session workspace and Android devices
Execute device-side shell commands when explicitly enabled
